pages.text: TechCraft adds advanced armor sets with unique properties. Each set provides different levels of protection and special abilities:$(br)• Prismite Armor$(br)• Quantum Armor

pages.title: Prismite Helmet
pages.text: Helmet made from prismite, providing diamond-level protection with unique refractive properties.

pages.title: Prismite Chestplate
pages.text: Chestplate made from prismite, offering excellent protection.

pages.title: Prismite Leggings
pages.text: Leggings made from prismite, providing good leg protection.

pages.title: Prismite Boots
pages.text: Boots made from prismite, offering solid foot protection.

pages.title: Quantum Helmet
pages.text: End-game helmet with netherite-level protection and quantum properties.
